scope: Linux isolated validation only; no production changes; no Windows 测试节点, Cloudflare, real remote device, hosted Actions or external model API validation

probe.server_selection: Test(MonitorControlFramesRefreshReadDeadline|OutputBudget|TaskDeadline); unrelated external ICMP/TCP/HTTP tests not run

checks: server-list weight ordering and stable selection
select filtered adds without losing hidden selection
offline last report timestamp and unknown state
keys collapsed by default and expandable
desktop and mobile single page scrollbar
native creation dialog with complete credential URL
panel log does not contain URL key
browser.scope: actual Linux loopback panel, fresh SQLite/admin login, bridge and Chromium; node presence uses a locally simulated probe HTTP report; no production, Windows 测试节点 or remote probe

build_matrix_scope: All configured targets compiled locally; cross-compiled operating systems not runtime tested
setup: Complete dev/setup.sh executed; subsequent changed source paths revalidated with relevant race tests, builds and native integration
clean_baseline_preparation: All three agent patches and overlay reconstructed and terminal/executionguard tests passed in a separate temporary clean clone

implemented_rules.renewal: new accepted command/interactive input only; never polling, heartbeat or duplicate command_id

limitations: slot bounds are not child-process or memory isolation
working-set pressure is approximate; no guarantee against OOM
missing upstream bytes cannot be replayed
restart does not preserve watchdogs or authorization leases
old probes cannot provide managed execution guard acknowledgement
persistent shell scope remains Linux POSIX /bin/sh
disabled force-close means ignored SIGINT remains uncertain
detached descendants can outlive terminal or task cancellation
probe configuration applied through managed terminal, not monitoring RPC
no Release created or main merged

toolchain.note: Release CI still pins Node 22; hosted CI was not run here

resource_validation: cgroup file fixtures and mocked resource-pressure admission, not real 256 MiB device stress
